reason: The cited lines show the tool fills a page form element with request.params.value, which can deliver agent-supplied data into a web page/DOM, so SINK is supported. They also show an optional response.includeSnapshot(), which returns a snapshot of the page; page contents may include non-public user/session data and may also be attacker-controlled web content, so SECRET and UNTRUSTED are supported. No arbitrary host code execution is shown.
